frame.purpose: Help doctors decide whether WMC is a suitable practice — then progress from enquiry to onboarding without recruitment-agency framing.
guards: No talent-pool / job-board framing on decision pages
No public percentage or earnings claims
Practice does not issue Medicare provider numbers
JobPosting schema only when a live vacancy exists

stages.name: Awareness
stages.goal: Doctor discovers WMC exists as a continuity-focused inner-south practice worth noticing.
questions: Which Brisbane practices still prioritise continuity?
Is there an AGPAL-accredited clinic in Woolloongabba / inner south?
Where do GPs at this practice publish how they work?
decisionFactors: Location credibility (468 Vulture Street, inner south)
Visibility in organic search and peer referral
requiredContent: Join Our Team / GP Opportunities landing (decision framing)
About Us, Philosophy of Care, Our Story, Community
AGPAL accreditation authority page
Meet the team / GP directory (public clinical presence)
requiredWebsiteFeatures: Primary nav Join Our Team (not buried)
SEO title/meta for GP decision intent
MedicalClinic + WebPage schema
Canonical URLs and internal links from About → Join Our Team
Mobile-readable trust marks (AGPAL) with text labels

stages.name: Interest
stages.goal: Doctor feels WMC might match their practice values and wants to learn more.
questions: Does this practice match how I want to practise?
Is the culture continuity-based or high-volume?
Will I have nursing and reception support?
Are part-time or staged sessions possible?
decisionFactors: Persona resonance (early career, established, returning, PT parent, special interest)
requiredContent: GP Opportunities hero + philosophy section
Why WMC / facilities / flexibility / clinical interests / collaboration
Persona-aligned messaging blocks (subtle, not labelled as personas publicly)
Short trust strip (AGPAL, location, care model, team)
requiredWebsiteFeatures: On-this-page anchors (philosophy, how we work, FAQ, EOI)
Accessible CTA pair: learn how we work + express interest
No JobBoard UI; soft EOI invitation only
Fast LCP on hero; meaningful image alt

stages.name: Research
stages.goal: Doctor verifies operational reality: support, systems, location, accreditation, provider-number honesty.
questions: What nursing/reception support exists day to day?
What technology and booking systems are used?
Where is parking and how do I get there?
Does the practice issue provider numbers?
What does AGPAL actually mean here?
decisionFactors: Transparency on commercial discussions (private, not public %)
requiredContent: GP FAQ (billing model, %, nursing, reception, sessions, autonomy, tech, AGPAL, registrars, PN, parking)
Access & Parking, Community, Local access
Team nursing / reception / practice management pages
Provider number readiness explainer (no issuance claim)
requiredWebsiteFeatures: FAQPage schema synced to visible FAQ
Internal links FAQ ↔ authority pages
Searchable/findable FAQ headings (H2/H3)
Print/share friendly FAQ section
Clear contact tel: and practice address

stages.name: Comparison
stages.goal: Doctor compares WMC against other practices on fit factors that matter to them.
questions: How does WMC differ from high-throughput clinics?
Will part-time be treated as real membership?
Can I develop clinical interests without becoming a boutique silo?
Is commercial discussion serious and private?
What would week-one support look like vs elsewhere?
requiredContent: Side-by-side decision cues on GP Opportunities (philosophy contrast language)
Flexible consulting + clinical interests sections
Persona-informed objection handling in FAQ
Network note: Healthcare Doctors network without losing local identity
requiredWebsiteFeatures: Scannable comparison-friendly layout (short sections, clear H3s)
Sticky or repeated EOI CTA after comparison content
No competitor naming; principle-based differentiation only
Optional Doctor Readiness Assessment as self-check (not a scoregate)

stages.name: Enquiry
stages.goal: Doctor starts a direct conversation with the practice via EOI or phone.
questions: How do I contact the practice without a job board?
What should I include in an expression of interest?
Who reviews my enquiry?
What happens after I submit?
decisionFactors: Confidence enquiry goes to the practice (not an agency)
requiredContent: Expression of Interest form copy (practice-direct)
Privacy note (no patient info; recruitment storage consent)
What happens next (review → practice contact)
Phone CTA (07) 3217 3344
requiredWebsiteFeatures: GP EOI form (name, email, phone, AHPRA, fellowships, interests, start date)
Client + server validation and accessible error messages
JSON submission model / secure careers API path when live
aria-live status; noscript fallback to phone/email
No public candidate marketplace listing

stages.name: Assessment
stages.goal: Doctor and practice assess mutual fit: readiness, credentials pathway, capacity.
questions: Am I operationally ready to onboard?
What documents am I missing?
Is there room/session capacity for me?
How does WMC evaluate fit beyond a CV?
decisionFactors: Room and session capacity at WMC
requiredContent: Doctor Readiness Assessment results language
Provider Number Readiness Workflow (score, missing items, checklist)
Room Capacity Dashboard outputs (for internal/practice use; public-safe summaries only if shared)
Honest next-action recommendations
requiredWebsiteFeatures: Doctor Readiness wizard (score + next action + JSON export)
Provider Number Readiness workflow (with non-issuance notice)
Room capacity tools for practice planning (admin/internal or gated)
Checklist export for doctor + practice shared understanding

stages.name: Session Planning
stages.goal: Agree a sustainable consulting footprint (days × morning/afternoon/evening).
questions: Which sessions can I realistically commit to?
What is estimated weekly capacity?
Which rooms/slots are free vs limited?
Can this grow over time?
requiredContent: Session planning guidance (planning only — not a roster contract)
Flexible consulting narrative from Join Our Team / Opportunities
Capacity legend explanation for doctors when shared
requiredWebsiteFeatures: GP Session Planner (weekly M/A/E selection, totals, JSON save)
Room Capacity Dashboard (available rooms, sessions, schedules)
Export/share JSON of preferred sessions for practice conversation
LocalStorage draft so planning survives refresh

stages.name: Onboarding
stages.goal: Complete practice onboarding after mutual yes — documents, orientation, go-live.
questions: What documents does the practice need?
What do I still need from Services Australia?
What orientation covers billing/systems?
When is my first consulting session?
decisionFactors: Provider number status for this location (SA-issued)
Confirmed session start and room assignment
requiredContent: Onboarding checklist (doctor / practice / Services Australia owners)
Missing-items list from readiness workflows
Links to practice policies, privacy, infection prevention (as relevant)
Welcome orientation outline (not public marketing)
requiredWebsiteFeatures: Provider Number Readiness checklist completion tracking
Secure document handoff path (existing careers application / admin inbox)
Admin careers applications workflow for practice team
Post-offer private checklist (not public careers hype)
Confirmation contact paths (phone/email)

journeyMap.description: Linear primary path with optional loops back to Research or Session Planning.

loops.when: Doctor needs more operational proof before enquiring
Readiness tools surface gaps; doctor updates EOI or calls
Preferred sessions conflict with capacity; reassess timing

exitRamps.reason: Another practice is a better fit
Credential/PN pathway not viable for intended start

publicWebsite.feature: Join Our Team employer-brand page + nav
GP Expression of Interest form + validation
